{{Top|leg}}
A '''Tessent''' was a type of [[Chalcedony/Legends|chalcedony]] idol made in the shape of [[Bird/Legends|bird]] with a [[Feline/Legends|cat-like]] head. Among treasure seekers in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]], there were rumored to be two Tessents: [[Ayrou Tessent|one]] related to the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]] of [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]] and [[Alsakan Tessent|another]] that was associated with the ancient Kings of [[Archais (kingdom)|Archais]].
